prompt: I am about to hand this investigation to a different agent session. Package the small set of code objects I have gathered into one compact manifest they can later rehydrate into full detail, so they do not repeat the exploration I already did.
rationale: Save/load of compact manifests for agent handoff is this tool's stated purpose. get_context hydrates ids for the caller now; it does not persist a manifest for a later session.
answer_key_evidence: Capture and hydrate code context manifests for efficient agent handoff
